messages:
alex: Quick design question — I'm sketching a hybrid collector approach: small agent on host that does minimal local processing for spans/metrics (sampling, batching, local dedupe), and a central gateway that handles heavy exporters (S3/long-term storage), tenant-level retention, and complex routing. Anyone sees major pitfalls?

maria: high-level sounds fine. main worry is backpressure propagation and data loss during gateway outage. how do you plan to spool/queue? :thinking_face:

alex: thinking disk-backed spool + bounded memory queue + exporter backoff. agent should fallback to best-effort direct-export to gateway replicas in other regions before dropping. also want per-signal pipelines so metrics don't get mixed with spans processing.

devon: per-signal pipelines are good. for spans we should keep a tiny local sampling processor (probabilistic + dynamic target rate) so we avoid blowing uplink with noisy services. sample config needs to be centrally tunable per-tenant.

samir: agree on tunable sampling. and add a cheap dedupe/aggregation step in agent for high-cardinality debug traces to reduce churn. also export fanout is tricky — if we fanout to jaeger + s3 + analytics, slow exporter kills the chain. need an exporter failing isolation.

zoe: exporter isolation + retry queues per-exporter. prefer pushing long-term export to gateway only; agent never talks to S3 directly. keeps credentials simpler.

alex: good point about credentials. wanted agent->gateway for long-term exports. gateway will sign/forward to S3/BigQuery. agent can do short-term local retention (hours) for immediate replays.

infra-bot: deploy-bot: noted — new proposal branch created: refs/collectors/hybrid-split. CI will run config lint.

maria: UX question for console teams: we'll need a single place to edit per-tenant routing + sampling + retention. rollout needs canary by tenant and by region. console should show effective policy per-tenant and explain why a span took path X -> Y.

alex: +1. tracing team asked for telemetry for routing decisions: counters for "routed_to_gateway", "direct_export", "dropped_due_to_quota", and per-tenant queue_depth histogram. those should feed the dashboards and alerting.

devon: alert thresholds: queue_depth > 75% for 2m -> page. stalled exporters for 1m -> critical. dropped_spans/sec > baseline*5 -> paging w/ tenant id.

samir: retention model: tenant-level ttl for spans in gateway (days/weeks), plus cold export to object storage. need policy for migration when TTL changes mid-retention window. gateway should annotate exported blobs with effective policy version.

zoe: we also need schema migration story for new span attributes — exporter consumers (analytics) may need versioned records. gateway should publish a schema-version header.

alex: sharing a rough opentelemetry config for agent I had in mind, keep it minimal:

```
receivers:
  otlp:
    protocols:
      grpc: {}
processors:
  batch:
    timeout: 200ms
  sampling:
    probabilistic:
      sampling_percentage: 5
exporters:
  otlp/gateway:
    endpoint: "gateway.internal:4317"
service:
  pipelines:
    traces:
      receivers: [otlp]
      processors: [sampling, batch]
      exporters: [otlp/gateway]
```

alex: agent config must be able to hot-reload sampling percentage from central control plane. no restart.

maria: hot-reload + delta rollout. console should show change history & rollback. also need per-tenant override via API for SRE runbooks.

samir: during gateway outage plan: agents should increase local retention window and reduce sampling to keep high-value paths. need a circuit-breaker: if gateway errors > X% for Y seconds, switch to degraded mode.

devon: testing: we should create synthetic noisy services and run chaos tests that simulate gateways losing network. verify no silent data loss beyond policy.

zoe: ops-bot, can we add a runbook step for manual replay from agent spools to gateway once recovered?

ops-bot: ops-bot: added runbook "collector-agent-spool-replay" to runbooks repo. includes commands and safety checks.

alex: rollout plan idea: feature-flagged canary, start with 5 internal tenants, run for 48h, monitor queue depth, export latency, dropped spans. if stable, move to 25% of tenants, then 100%. metrics and alerting must be in place before canary.

maria: also add billing/quota tests — when sampling changes we will affect billable token counts. product needs to be in loop.

devon: ops concern: disk spool growth — cap per-host and eviction policy (oldest-first or lowest-priority-tenant-first?). prefer tenant-priority thresholds.

samir: eviction should be tenant-aware and record which spans were evicted (count) for auditing.

alex: good discussion. next steps: I'll push design doc to RFCs, include config examples, rollout checklist, and required console metrics. tagging @maria @devon @samir for review.

zoe: I'll coordinate with console folks and add the routing diagnostics panel mockup.

infra-bot: GitHub: created PR #482: "hybrid-collector-agent-gateway" (links: https://git.internal/r/482)

alex: thanks all. we'll sync on Monday 9am to finalize open items.
